title: Small Things Like These
author: Claire Keegan
summary: A short novel set in a small Irish town in the weeks before Christmas in 1985. A coal merchant and father of five makes a delivery that makes him question what the town prefers not to see, and what he can do about it.
readIf: you want a quiet, short, powerful read about conscience and small moments of courage.
skipIf: you want a lot of plot, or find stories about institutional cruelty hard to read.

pairings.reason: A restrained novel about a man whose silence costs him, told with the same careful understatement.
Short, quiet stories of ordinary lives in a small community, with a similar moral clarity.
Another story about a decent man facing a moral choice that cannot be undone.
